claims: The Masters Tournament is played annually at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia, USA.
The Masters Tournament is one of the four major championships in men's professional golf.
The Masters Tournament is the only major held at the same venue every year.
The Masters Tournament typically takes place in the first full week of April.
Augusta National Golf Club is located in Augusta, Georgia, U.S.
Augusta National Golf Club was established in 1934.
"Amen Corner" covers holes 11, 12, and 13 at Augusta National Golf Club.
The Masters Tournament always takes place on the second Sunday in April.
Other major golf championships rotate locations.
Augusta National Golf Club is the permanent home of the Masters Tournament
